description: About to depend on a public HTTPS service? Register what a good response looks like (`checks`: http_status_in, content_type_is, non_empty, json_parses) and get a `terms_id`. Then call witness_delivery to have GAIP independently check what the service returns. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).
name: witness_register_terms
